data.name: Malakah
data.gender_notes: Malakah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malakah refers to an angel or a messenger in Islamic tradition. It signifies a spiritual being or a divine envoy. The name Malakah carries the meaning “Angel, Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malakah usually hope their child will grow to embody angel, messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, angels (Malakah) are described as spiritual beings created by Allah to serve as messengers and agents.
data.etymology: Malakah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Angel, Messenger.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malakah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ملاكه
in_arabic.meaning: ملاك أو كائن سماوي، روحاني، قوي ورفيع المستوى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ملاكة مشتق من كلمة ملاك، وتعني الكائن السماوي أو الروحاني الذي يتميز بالقوة والرفعة. وردت الكلمة في القرآن الكريم، وتدل على المخلوقات السماوية التي تتمتع بالقدرة الربانية. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم ملاكة تعبيرًا عن الجمال والروحانية.

in_urdu.name: ملاکہ
in_urdu.meaning: فرشتہ یا روحانی وجود، قوی اور بلند مرتبہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملاکہ نام فرشتے یا روحانی وجود سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قوت اور بلندی کی علامت ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے ملاکہ کا تعلق ملاک (فرشتہ) سے ہے، جو قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، ملاکہ نام روحانی خوبصورتی اور اعلیٰ اخلاق کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मलाकाह
in_hindi.meaning: दिव्य प्राणी या स्वर्गीय सत्ता, शक्तिशाली और उच्च स्तर का
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलाकाह नाम दिव्य प्राणी या स्वर्गीय सत्ता से लिया गया है, जो शक्ति और उच्चता का प्रतीक है। इस नाम का अरबी मूल मलाक (दूत) से है, जो कुरआन में उल्लिखित है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, मलाकाह नाम आध्यात्मिक सौंदर्य और उच्च आदर्शों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_pashto.name: ملاکه
in_pashto.meaning: فرښته یا روحاني وجود، قوي او لوړ رتبه
in_pashto.long_meaning: ملاکه نوم د فرښتې یا روحاني وجود څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د قدرت او لوړتیا نښه ده. د عربي ريښو څخه ملاکه د ملاک (فرشته) سره تړاو لري، کوم چې په قرآن کريم کې ياد شوی دی. د افغان او پښتون دوديز ثقافت کې، ملاکه نوم د روحاني ښکلا او لوړو اخلاقو استازیتوب کوي.

in_english.name: Malakah
in_english.meaning: Angel or heavenly being, powerful and of high rank
in_english.long_meaning: The name Malakah is derived from the Arabic word 'malak,' meaning angel or heavenly being. This term is found in the Quran, signifying a powerful and elevated creature. In Islamic tradition, Malakah represents spiritual beauty, high moral standards, and divine presence. The name symbolizes strength, purity, and a connection to the spiritual realm.

It is also reflected in various aspects of daily life, as many Muslim beliefs and practices revolve around the concept of angels including seeking their protection during prayers and invoking their names for blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic name Malakah holds deep spiritual significance, as it symbolizes the idea of Divine communication and connection between the mortal world and the heavenly realm. Angels are considered as vessels of God's mercy, caring for human beings, and guiding them while they navigate their spiritual journey on Earth. This name resonates with believers, reminding them that that they are never alone in their spiritual pursuit and that the divine presence is always with them in the form of guardian angels.
